description.en: Lets your site answer the commands typed in your Twitch chat (!game, !title, !schedule…), with ready-made commands and your own, timers, commands managed from the chat and an import from Nightbot. Includes an emergency switch and a short log of what it answered.
description.fr: Fait répondre votre site aux commandes tapées dans votre chat Twitch (!jeu, !titre, !planning…), avec des commandes toutes prêtes et les vôtres, des timers, la gestion des commandes depuis le chat et un import depuis Nightbot. Avec un bouton d'arrêt d'urgence et un court journal de ce qui a été répondu.

label.en: What your home did with the rewards (from the Home Assistant connector, if installed)
label.fr: Ce que votre maison a fait des récompenses (fourni par le Connecteur Home Assistant, s'il est installé)

label.en: Whether your home is switched on and you are live (from the Home Assistant connector, if installed)
label.fr: Si votre maison est branchée et si vous êtes en direct (fourni par le Connecteur Home Assistant, s'il est installé)

label.en: Your Twitch follower count (from My Twitch channel)
label.fr: Votre nombre de followers Twitch (fourni par Ma Chaîne Twitch)

label.en: Your next streams (from your calendars, if installed)
label.fr: Vos prochains streams (fournis par vos agendas, s'ils sont installés)

label.en: Your social network links (from the network modules, if installed)
label.fr: Les liens de vos réseaux (fournis par les modules de réseaux, s'ils sont installés)

label.en: The names of the actions your rewards can start at home (for the Home Assistant connector)
label.fr: Les noms des actions que vos récompenses peuvent lancer chez vous (pour le Connecteur Home Assistant)

title.fr: Commande de chat pour ce partenaire

help.en: Let your Twitch chat get this partner's link with a command. This part saves on its own with its own button, apart from the page's Save button.
help.fr: Permettez à votre chat Twitch d'obtenir le lien de ce partenaire avec une commande. Cette partie s'enregistre toute seule avec son propre bouton, à part du bouton Enregistrer de la page.

label.en: create, change and delete the channel point rewards
label.fr: créer, modifier et supprimer les récompenses en points de chaîne

help.en: These rewards really exist on Twitch and can switch things on in your home.
help.fr: Ces récompenses existent vraiment sur Twitch et peuvent allumer des choses chez vous.

label.en: create, change, delete and send the chat timers
label.fr: créer, modifier, supprimer et envoyer les timers du chat

help.en: Timers write messages in your Twitch chat on their own.
help.fr: Les timers écrivent des messages dans votre chat Twitch sans que personne ne les tape.

label.en: import commands and timers from Nightbot
label.fr: importer des commandes et des timers depuis Nightbot

help.en: Creates or replaces several chat commands and timers at once.
help.fr: Permet de créer ou de remplacer plusieurs commandes et timers du chat en une fois.

privacy.en: When someone types a command, the bot keeps their Twitch username, the command and whether it answered in a short log (last 30 entries, seen only by the administration team); for channel point rewards, the last 50 exchanges (username, reward, outcome, never the viewer's message). Timers keep only what you write and their last send time. A pasted Nightbot list is a draft kept 24 hours at most. Chat words used by a command, and giveaway entries, are never kept.
privacy.fr: Quand une personne tape une commande, le bot garde son pseudo Twitch, la commande et la réponse ou non dans un court journal (30 lignes, visible de l'équipe d'administration seule) ; pour les récompenses, les 50 derniers échanges (pseudo, récompense, résultat, jamais le message). Les timers gardent ce que vous écrivez et l'heure de leur dernier envoi. Une liste Nightbot collée est gardée 24 h au plus. Les mots tapés dans une commande et les participations à un tirage ne sont jamais gardés.

label.fr: Commandes
label.en: Commands

label.fr: Timers
label.en: Timers

label.fr: Récompenses
label.en: Rewards
Tell the chat when points are given back
label.fr: Prévenir le chat quand des points sont rendus

help.en: When a reward could not be played (home switched off, not live…), the bot writes a short message in the chat. Off by default.
help.fr: Quand une récompense n'a pas pu être jouée (maison coupée, pas en direct…), le bot écrit un court message dans le chat. Désactivé par défaut.

label.en: Moderators who may type !stop
label.fr: Équipe de modération qui peut taper !stop

help.en: Their Twitch names, separated by commas, for example marie_mod, paul_mod. You can always type !stop and !start yourself. Moderators cannot restart: only you can.
help.fr: Leurs pseudos Twitch, séparés par des virgules, par exemple marie_mod, paul_mod. Vous pouvez toujours taper !stop et !start vous-même. L'équipe de modération ne peut pas redémarrer : vous êtes la seule personne à pouvoir le faire.

label.en: How long to wait for the home before giving points back (seconds)
label.fr: Attente de la maison avant de rendre les points (secondes)

help.en: Between 30 and 600. If the home has not answered after this delay, the points are given back the next time something happens on your channel or when you open this page.
help.fr: Entre 30 et 600. Si la maison n'a pas répondu après ce délai, les points sont rendus la prochaine fois qu'il se passe quelque chose sur votre chaîne ou que vous ouvrez cette page.

label.en: Other actions you can pick (advanced)
label.fr: Autres actions à choisir (avancé)

help.en: Words separated by commas that your home understands, for example scene:cinema. Lowercase letters, digits, “:” “_” “-”, 40 characters at most. Each word is listed in “Your actions” (the word is its name). For a new action, rather pick “Something else at my place” in a reward and give it a name.
help.fr: Des mots séparés par des virgules que votre maison comprend, par exemple scene:cinema. Lettres minuscules, chiffres, « : » « _ » « - », 40 caractères au plus. Chaque mot est repris dans « Vos actions » (le mot est son nom). Pour une nouvelle action, il est plus simple de choisir « Autre chose chez moi » dans une récompense et de lui donner un nom.

label.en: Show the technical identifiers of the actions
label.fr: Montrer les identifiants techniques des actions

help.en: To link your home by hand: the identifier of each action (for example perso:start-the-vacuum) is shown next to its name, and can be written for a new action or changed. Unticked, it is never shown.
help.fr: Pour relier la maison à la main : l'identifiant de chaque action (par exemple perso:lancer-l-aspirateur) est montré à côté de son nom, et peut être écrit pour une nouvelle action ou modifié. Décoché, il n'est jamais montré.

label.en: Answer only while I am live
label.fr: Répondre seulement quand je suis en direct

help.en: Untick it to answer all the time, even when your stream is off.
help.fr: Décochez pour répondre tout le temps, même quand votre stream est éteint.

label.en: Let the moderation team manage commands from the chat
label.fr: Laisser l'équipe de modération gérer les commandes depuis le chat

help.en: With it, you and your moderators can type !addcom, !editcom, !delcom and !commands in the chat. Off by default.
help.fr: Avec cette case, vous et votre équipe de modération pouvez taper !addcom, !editcom, !delcom et !commands dans le chat. Désactivé par défaut.

label.en: Your time zone (for the time of your next stream)
label.fr: Votre fuseau horaire (pour l'heure de votre prochain stream)

help.en: For example Europe/Paris or America/Montreal. Without it, times are given in UTC and say so.
help.fr: Par exemple Europe/Paris ou America/Montreal. Sans cela, les heures sont données en UTC et le disent.

label.en: Account that answers in the chat
label.fr: Compte qui répond dans le chat

help.en: By default your own account answers. Choose “A separate bot account” to have another Twitch account answer: you will connect it in the “Commands” tab.
help.fr: Par défaut, c'est votre propre compte qui répond. Choisissez « Un compte bot séparé » pour qu'un autre compte Twitch réponde : vous le connecterez dans l'onglet « Commandes ».

label.en: My own account
label.fr: Mon propre compte

label.en: A separate bot account
label.fr: Un compte bot séparé

label.en: Twitch channel to serve
label.fr: Chaîne Twitch à servir

help.en: Only asked when your site has several Twitch channels: the bot answers in the chat of this one. Leave empty to use the first one.
help.fr: Demandé seulement si votre site a plusieurs chaînes Twitch : le bot répond dans le chat de celle-ci. Laissez vide pour utiliser la première.

label.en: Start of a command
label.fr: Début d'une commande

help.en: The sign before the command name. “!” by default. 1 to 3 characters, no letter, no digit, never “/” or “.”.
help.fr: Le signe qui précède le nom de la commande. « ! » par défaut. 1 à 3 caractères, ni lettre ni chiffre, jamais « / » ni « . ».

label.en: Default wait between two answers of a command (seconds)
label.fr: Attente par défaut entre deux réponses d'une commande (secondes)

help.en: Everyone together: a command answers at most once per this delay. Each command can have its own.
help.fr: Tout le monde ensemble : une commande répond au plus une fois par ce délai. Chaque commande peut avoir le sien.

label.en: Default wait for each person (seconds)
label.fr: Attente par défaut pour chaque personne (secondes)

help.en: The same person must wait this long before the same command answers them again.
help.fr: Une même personne doit attendre ce délai avant que la même commande lui réponde de nouveau.

label.en: Answers allowed per 30 seconds, all commands together
label.fr: Réponses permises par tranche de 30 secondes, toutes commandes confondues

help.en: From 1 to 18. Twitch limits what a chat account may send: stay well under it.
help.fr: De 1 à 18. Twitch limite ce qu'un compte peut envoyer dans le chat : restez bien en dessous.

label.en: Age beyond which a message from Twitch is refused (minutes)
label.fr: Âge au-delà duquel un message de Twitch est refusé (minutes)

help.en: From 1 to 10. Protects against messages replayed later. Lower it only if your server's clock is very accurate.
help.fr: De 1 à 10. Protège contre les messages rejoués plus tard. Ne baissez que si l'horloge de votre serveur est très juste.

label.en: Other bots to ignore (optional)
label.fr: Autres bots à ignorer (facultatif)

help.en: Usernames separated by commas. The usual chat bots are already ignored.
help.fr: Pseudos séparés par des virgules. Les bots de chat courants sont déjà ignorés.

label.en: Websites that {urlfetch} may read (optional)
label.fr: Sites que {urlfetch} peut lire (facultatif)

help.en: One website name per line, for example api.example.org. Empty means {urlfetch} is switched off. Only https, never a private address, no redirection followed, 3 seconds, 400 characters.
help.fr: Un nom de site par ligne, par exemple api.example.org. Vide, {urlfetch} est éteint. Seulement en https, jamais une adresse privée, aucune redirection suivie, 3 secondes, 400 caractères.

mcp.name: bot_commands_list
mcp.description: List the chat commands of the Twitch bot of this site: custom ones, ready-made ones (planning, game, title, followers, uptime), partner commands and social network commands, plus the command prefix and whether the emergency switch has muted the bot. For each command: kind, name, aliases, reply text (with {variables}), enabled, who may use it (everyone, subscribers, mods, owner), state (on, off, hidden when something is missing, missing when the source is gone) and the delays in seconds (null = the default). Use it to answer 'what commands does my bot have?' before changing anything.

mcp.name: bot_command_create
mcp.description: Create a custom chat command. 'name' has no prefix (for 'merch' viewers type !merch). 'text' is the reply; it may contain these variables only: {followers} {jeu} {titre} {uptime} {prochain_stream} {utilisateur} (game, title, time since the live started, next stream, the name of the person typing), {viewers} {chaine} {heure} {date} (viewers now, channel name, time and date, optionally with a time zone: {heure Europe/Paris}), {cible} (first word after the command, without @), {requete} (everything after the command), {1} {2} {1:} (words after the command), {compteur} (how many times the command was used), {aleatoire a | b | c} or {aleatoire 1-100}, {calcul 2+3*4} (arithmetic only) and {urlfetch https://…} (only for websites the owner allowed in advanced settings). It cannot start with / or . or the prefix, and is cut at 500 characters. Names and aliases must not collide with another command. Refused with an explanation otherwise. The command is enabled unless 'enabled' is false.

activeFrom.description: Optional start of a validity period: 'MM-DD' (comes back every year, for example '11-01' for 1 November) or 'YYYY-MM-DD' (one single period). Give activeUntil too. Outside the period the command does not answer; the on/off switch always wins.

activeUntil.description: End of the validity period, included, same form as activeFrom ('11-30'). A period across new year is fine ('12-15' to '01-15').

yearly.description: true = comes back every year (default with 'MM-DD'), false = one single period (needs 'YYYY-MM-DD' dates).

name.description: Command name without the prefix, letters/digits/-/_ only, 25 characters at most.

aliases.description: Other names for the same command (5 at most).

delayAllSeconds.description: Minimum seconds between two answers of this command, everyone together.

delayPerPersonSeconds.description: Minimum seconds before the same person gets this command answered again.

mcp.name: bot_command_update
mcp.description: Change an existing chat command, found by its current name or alias (without the prefix): custom, ready-made, partner or network commands that are already set up. Only the fields you give change. Same rules as for creation (variables, collisions, no leading / or .). It can also enable or disable a command. It cannot delete anything and cannot send messages.

activeFrom.description: Optional start of a validity period: 'MM-DD' (comes back every year, for example '11-01' for 1 November) or 'YYYY-MM-DD' (one single period). Give activeUntil too. Outside the period the command does not answer; the on/off switch always wins.

activeUntil.description: End of the validity period, included, same form as activeFrom ('11-30'). A period across new year is fine ('12-15' to '01-15').

yearly.description: true = comes back every year (default with 'MM-DD'), false = one single period (needs 'YYYY-MM-DD' dates).

clearPeriod.description: true removes the validity period (always active again).

name.description: Current name or alias, without the prefix.

aliases.description: The complete list of aliases (replaces the old one).

role.description: Who may use it: everyone, subscribers, mods or owner.

enabled.description: True to switch the command on, false to switch it off.

delayAllSeconds.description: Seconds to wait between two answers, for everyone together (0 to 3600).

delayPerPersonSeconds.description: Seconds to wait between two answers to the same person (0 to 3600).

mcp.name: rewards_list
mcp.description: List the channel point rewards created by this site on Twitch: name, cost in points, delay in seconds, help text, whether the viewer writes a message, the action it triggers (its identifier, like lumieres:rouge or chat:repondre to answer in the chat, and its readable name), and its state (active, paused, refused, gone). Also gives the maximum number of rewards and the actions that may be used, with their names. Use it before creating or changing anything.

mcp.name: reward_create
mcp.description: Create a REAL channel point reward on Twitch (needs a Twitch Affiliate or Partner channel). 'name' is the title viewers see (45 characters at most, unique). 'costPoints' is a whole number from 1. 'action' must be one of the actions given by rewards_list; or give 'customActionName' (for example 'Start the vacuum') to use or create a named action of your own; home actions need the Home Assistant connector. 'chatReply' is required for chat:repondre and may contain {utilisateur} and {recompense}. Refused with an explanation otherwise.

name.description: Title of the reward as viewers see it (reward_update: its current title).

costPoints.description: Cost in channel points, a whole number from 1.

action.description: What happens when taken: an identifier from rewards_list allowedActions, for example lumieres:rouge.

customActionName.description: Instead of 'action': the name of an action of your own, for example Start the vacuum. An existing name uses the same action; a new name creates it.

delaySeconds.description: Delay between two uses, 0 for none.

helpText.description: One sentence shown under the title, 200 characters at most.

viewerWritesMessage.description: True if the viewer must write a message (always on for tts:lire).

chatReply.description: Answer written in the chat (only for chat:repondre); may use {utilisateur} and {recompense}.

mcp.name: reward_simulate
mcp.description: Simulate one reward WITHOUT Twitch and without points: runs the same path as a real exchange with a fake viewer named Test. A home action is really sent to the home (lights change, voice speaks) and the result is awaited for a few seconds; a chat answer is only previewed, never sent. Refused when the home emergency switch is on. For the voice reward 'text' is required (300 characters at most). Limits: one test every 3 seconds, 30 per hour.

name.description: Title of the reward as viewers see it (reward_update: its current title).

text.description: The viewer's message to read aloud (only for the voice reward), 300 characters at most.

mcp.name: reward_update
mcp.description: Change a REAL channel point reward created by this site on Twitch, found by its current 'name' (see rewards_list). Give only what changes: 'newName', 'costPoints', 'action', 'delaySeconds', 'helpText', 'viewerWritesMessage', 'chatReply'. Same limits and explanations as reward_create. It cannot delete a reward or pause it.

name.description: Title of the reward as viewers see it (reward_update: its current title).

costPoints.description: Cost in channel points, a whole number from 1.

action.description: What happens when taken: an identifier from rewards_list allowedActions, for example lumieres:rouge.

customActionName.description: Instead of 'action': the name of an action of your own, for example Start the vacuum. An existing name uses the same action; a new name creates it.

delaySeconds.description: Delay between two uses in seconds, 0 for none.

helpText.description: One sentence shown under the title, 200 characters at most.

viewerWritesMessage.description: True if the viewer must write a message (always on for tts:lire).

chatReply.description: Answer written in the chat (only for chat:repondre); may use {utilisateur} and {recompense}.

mcp.name: timers_list
mcp.description: List the chat timers of the Twitch bot: name, message (with {variables}), every how many minutes, how many chat lines at least since its last message, whether it works only while live, and whether it is enabled. A timer is only checked when a chat message arrives (there is no background clock), so it needs an active chat.

mcp.name: timer_create
mcp.description: Create a chat timer: a message the bot writes in the chat by itself. 'text' may use the same variables as a custom command except those about the person typing ({utilisateur}, {cible}, {requete}, {1}, {compteur}); it cannot start with / or . or the prefix and is cut at 450 characters. At most 20 timers. Refused with an explanation otherwise.

activeFrom.description: Optional start of a validity period: 'MM-DD' (comes back every year, for example '11-01' for 1 November) or 'YYYY-MM-DD' (one single period). Give activeUntil too. Outside the period the timer does not answer; the on/off switch always wins.

activeUntil.description: End of the validity period, included, same form as activeFrom ('11-30'). A period across new year is fine ('12-15' to '01-15').

yearly.description: true = comes back every year (default with 'MM-DD'), false = one single period (needs 'YYYY-MM-DD' dates).

minChatLines.description: Chat lines needed since its last message (default 5).

when.description: live = only while the stream is live (default), always.

mcp.name: timer_update
mcp.description: Change a chat timer, found by its current name. Only the fields you give change. Same rules as for creation. It can also enable or disable the timer. It cannot delete anything and cannot send a message.

activeFrom.description: Optional start of a validity period: 'MM-DD' (comes back every year, for example '11-01' for 1 November) or 'YYYY-MM-DD' (one single period). Give activeUntil too. Outside the period the timer does not answer; the on/off switch always wins.

activeUntil.description: End of the validity period, included, same form as activeFrom ('11-30'). A period across new year is fine ('12-15' to '01-15').

yearly.description: true = comes back every year (default with 'MM-DD'), false = one single period (needs 'YYYY-MM-DD' dates).

clearPeriod.description: true removes the validity period (always active again).

mcp.name: nightbot_import_preview
mcp.description: Read a list of Nightbot commands and timers pasted as text (table copied from the Nightbot dashboard, one '!name message' per line, or JSON) and say, for each line, whether it can be taken as is, adapted (old $(variables) translated, user level mapped: Nightbot 'regular' becomes subscribers) or is impossible, with the reason. Writes NOTHING. At most 200 lines.

mcp.name: nightbot_import
mcp.description: Import a pasted list of Nightbot commands and timers (same reading as nightbot_import_preview) and create the importable ones. A name that already exists is handled by 'onConflict': skip (default), replace (only custom commands and timers) or rename. Lines that are impossible are never imported. 'only' limits the import to the given command or timer names. At most 200 lines, 100 custom commands and 20 timers.

onConflict.description: What to do when the name already exists (default skip).
